{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-read the data with proper parsing of revenue
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check the data types and first few rows again
print(sales_df.dtypes)
print(sales_df.head())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("\nCustomer age -1 count:", (sales_df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check the value counts of customer_segment
print("\nCustomer segment counts:\n", sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check the value counts of converted
print("\nConverted counts:\n", sales_df['converted'].value_counts())"}
